scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.dev:desktop: concurrently -n api,web,desktop -c green,cyan,magenta -k "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && npm run dev -w apps/desktop"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/types && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
